主要内容: In January 2016, Bloomberg reported on Haier Group's ambitious strategy to expand into the U.S. market. The article highlighted Haier's long-standing presence in China, where it produced one out of every three refrigerators sold as of 2003. Despite its success in China, Haier faced challenges in the U.S., where American consumers were skeptical about the quality of Chinese brands and preferred domestic labels. The company's efforts to enter the U.S. market began in 1999, but it took a year to secure a meeting with Wal-Mart Stores Inc. to showcase its air-conditioners. The article also mentioned a photo of a customer shopping for a Haier air conditioner at a Suning home appliances store in Qingdao, Shandong province, on March 13, 2015.
